rationale: The tape shows a sharp intraday markdown on 2.4x relative volume while the broad market is up ~1%, meaning this is idiosyncratic distribution, not beta. The bounce off the $9.86 low has stalled for the last ~25 minutes in a tight $10.35–$10.38 coil right at/below the 5-min VWAP and 9-EMA, with volume drying up — sellers are capping every push, lower highs persist from $11.41, and price sits in the lower third of the daily range with 66 minutes left, a configuration that typically resolves in the trend direction into the close. Size is kept small and the stop placed above the coil ($10.52) because compression can break either way and both the catalyst for the selloff and short-borrow conditions are unknown.
